name: sgs/trust-bar
title: SGS Trust Bar
description: Horizontal strip of trust signals. Three variants: icon-in-circle (default), text-only pill badges, and image-badge (certification logos). Typed mode only: curated items[] repeater.

sgs._comment_overlayNotAdopted: The background is the media system's `background` slot (supports.sgs.mediaElements, Spec 49 section 7.8): the Background panel is the shared media panel, and SGS_Container_Wrapper (via SGS_Background_Media) prints the element and overlay. An SVG drawn over a photo or video is the block's own kept layer (bgSvg* attributes).
sgs._comment_trim: A trust bar is one row or one grid of badges, so the shared Layout panel leaves out what a one-row strip never uses. Default and Stack stay offered on a bar that already stores one; a custom column template, row template, auto rows, justify items and align content stay shown on a bar that stores one. Columns (Grid) is the one column control.
sgs._comment_mediaElements: The `badge` slot: each image badge's own picture (`items[].source`) printed by the shared media renderer, with the block-level Fit (contain when unset), Width (60px when unset), Radius, Shape and Colour. The `background` slot is the bar's own background.

wrapper.label: Section wrapper
wrapper._layer_note: section-KIND composite rendered via SGS_Container_Wrapper (D294 — keeps the wrapper, genuine grid/section). This element is both the block root and the grid definition, mirroring sgs/card-grid's grid element.
wrapper._note: gridTemplateColumns/Rows, gap, justify-*/align-content/flex-* are consumed by SGS_Container_Wrapper via the universal wrapper mechanism (render.php:214-220 comment). No alignItems/display/overflow/aspect-ratio/width/height/max-height attrs exist — honest gaps.

icon-badge.absentWhy: The icon circle exists only in the icon-circle badge style.
icon-badge.label: Icon circle only (icon-circle variant)
icon-badge._note: iconColour (the SVG stroke/fill colour, style.css:80 `color: var(--sgs-trust-badge-icon-colour, ...)`) resolves via css:color (text cluster) — mirrors sgs/icon's own icon element + sgs/business-info's icon element, which use the same functional-icon-colour/css:color convention (Spec 35 vocabulary fix). Only applies when badgeStyle='icon-circle' (supports.sgs.variants). `css:stroke` (D636/D644 icon/SVG gradient mechanism) explicit-mapped to iconColourGradient, added 2026-08-16 (Builder 4) — non-empty wins over iconColour's flat currentColor paint at render time (helpers-svg-gradient.php). iconColourHover pairs with the resting iconColour above (2026-09-02) — render.php re-points `--sgs-trust-badge-icon-colour` on `.sgs-trust-bar__badge` while that item is hovered or focused, so the icon (plain or circled) changes colour with its item; the element it belongs to is icon-badge, matching check-hover-state-classification.py's resting-twin discriminator.

label.label: Badge text
label._note: The badge's text in every style: the icon styles print it as .sgs-trust-bar__label, text-only and image-badge as .sgs-trust-bar__badge-label. Typography (labelFontSize and the rest) and the one Label colour (labelColour, with its gradient and hover pair) cover both class names: render.php prints the same rule for each. A text bar always paints `labelColour` (default `text`), as before. An icon bar paints `.sgs-trust-bar__label` only when a label colour other than the default (or a gradient or a hover colour) is stored; until then it keeps the label colour in textColour (render.php: textColour -> --sgs-trust-badge-text-colour -> style.css `.sgs-trust-bar--icon-circle .sgs-trust-bar__label`), so no saved bar changes. `labelColourHover` and its gradient re-colour the text on hover; this element declares no css:background-color of its own (that lives on the `wrapper` element), so no bg-layer precondition applies.

title.label: Title
title._note: titleColourHover/titleColourHoverGradient (2026-09-07) added the hover pair — this element declares no css:background-color of its own (that lives on the separate `wrapper` element/selector), so no bg-layer precondition applies.

item.label: Each badge (icon and text)
item._note: The badge box of every variant (`.sgs-trust-bar__badge` as rendered; a draft may write it as `__item`, the element key per-area routing matches on, keyed on the draft's BEM element token). Declared `layer: GRID_AREA` (a per-child area of the band, like sgs/hero's content area) so the css_layer classifier does NOT fall back to its arrangement rule, which labelled itemGap GRID and let the icon-to-label gap capture the band's own items gap (`gap: 6px 32px`) that belongs in `gap`. itemGap is the icon-to-label gap inside one badge; itemPadding is the badge's own padding; both are responsive tier objects emitted as scoped rules on `.{uid}.wp-block-sgs-trust-bar .sgs-trust-bar__badge` by includes/helpers-trust-bar-item.php::sgs_trust_bar_item_css. Per-item fillStyle/fillColour (image-badge and text-only item content) remain repeater-row fields, not block-level style controls.

text-badge.label: Word badge only (text-only variant)
text-badge._note: The text-only badge (`.sgs-trust-bar__badge`) draws a pill by default (surface-alt fill, 1px border, 999px radius). These four settings are unset by default (the pill stays); a draft whose strip is plain words sets a transparent fill, a 0 width and a 0 radius. Printed as a scoped rule by includes/helpers-trust-bar-item.php::sgs_trust_bar_text_badge_css, with the fill and border colour repeated on :hover so the stylesheet's hover pill does not return.

separator.label: Separator glyph
separator._note: A decorative mark (aria-hidden) between the badges, in every badge style and every layout: textBadgeSeparator is the glyph itself (free text, e.g. a star, at most 8 characters) and textBadgeSeparatorColour its colour. A row (flex, stack, default) prints it as a sibling after every badge, the last included, so the marquee's copies join with one; style.css hides the last one while the bar is not scrolling. A grid prints it inside each badge and centres it on the column gap (includes/helpers-trust-bar-grid.php); the badge at the end of each row has none.

icon-bare.absentWhy: The bare icon exists only in the icon-bare badge style.
icon-bare.label: Bare icon only (icon-bare variant)
icon-bare._note: The `.sgs-trust-bar__icon` span in the icon-bare variant: the icon on its own with no circle behind it, at iconBareSize px. Colour, gradient, hover and stroke width are the same attributes as the icon-circle variant (iconColour, iconColourGradient, iconColourHover, iconStrokeWidth, declared on the icon-badge element). Emitted only when badgeStyle=icon-bare.

badge-img.absentWhy: The badge image exists only in the image-badge style.
badge-img.label: Badge image only (image-badge variant)
badge-img._note: The picture inside the image-badge variant's `.sgs-trust-bar__badge-img` box (render.php). Its size, fit, corners, shape and colour are the `badge` media slot's own settings; the shadow is the block's and sits on the picture. Emitted only when badgeStyle=image-badge.

background.label: Background
background._note: `.sgs-bg-media`, the element SGS_Container_Wrapper prints for every background (picture, tile layer, video or SVG). A motion target so a Ken Burns or parallax layer moves the background alone, never the block's content; it declares no style clusters because its look is governed by the Background panel.

background-video.label: Background video
background-video._note: The same `.sgs-bg-media` element when a device shows a video: an effect that suits video (not Ken Burns) reaches it through this part.

svg-bg.label: Background SVG
svg-bg._note: `.sgs-container__svg-bg`, the wrapper SGS_Container_Wrapper prints around a background or foreground SVG (bgSvg*). A motion target so an SVG loop or `draw` effect layer reaches the SVG alone; it declares no style clusters because its look is governed by the bgSvg* controls.

overlay.label: Background overlay
overlay._note: The overlay span the shared background renderer prints as a direct child of the root (`.<uid> > .sgs-bg-overlay`, includes/media/background-css.php::sgs_bg_overlay_css; assets/css/media-bg.css places it). Declared so calibration reads what each overlay setting paints; not a motion target. Written by scripts/check-overlay-element.py --fix.

linkSource.description: Where the badge link goes: '' (the typed url), post:<id> (a page or post, followed by ID), a Site Info link (phone, email, whatsapp, directions, google, facebook, instagram, twitter, linkedin, youtube, tiktok) or top. Resolved by includes/helpers-link-source.php; the typed url is the fallback.

_key._note: Client-generated stable identity (src/utils/generateItemKey.js), not a client-visible field — no label, no editor control. Scopes this item's own object-fit CSS (image-badge variant only) so a fit value survives reorder/add/remove instead of following array index (Spec 35 Part 4). Backfilled silently on mount for items created before this field existed.

source.description: The item's picture per device, the media Source shape: {desktop:{kind,id,url,width,height,mime}, tablet, mobile}. A device with no entry shows the wider device's file.

alt.description: The picture's description for screen readers. Blank when the picture is decorative.

fit.description: How this item's picture fills its box per device. Empty uses the block's own fit.

titleColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of titleColourHover. Non-empty wins over titleColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible.

labelColour.description: The colour of the badge text in every style. A text-only or image-badge bar always paints its label with it (the default is the theme text colour). An icon bar paints its label with it only once a colour other than the default is stored (or a gradient or hover colour); until then the label keeps the colour in textColour.

labelColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of labelColourHover. Non-empty wins over labelColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible.

iconBareSize.description: icon-bare variant only. Icon size in px (8 to 96), independent of the icon-circle disc size and its 36-64px clamp.

iconStrokeWidth.description: Stroke width of the outline icon, for the icon-circle and icon-bare variants. 1.8 is the framework default. Applies to Lucide and raw-SVG icons alike. Clamped to 0.25 to 4.

itemGap.description: Responsive gap inside each badge item (icon to label), a {desktop,tablet,mobile} tier object of CSS lengths. Empty keeps the variant's own default gap.

itemPadding.description: 4-side box-object family (box_family 'itemPadding'), a {desktop,tablet,mobile} tier object of {top,right,bottom,left}. Padding of each badge item. Empty keeps the variant's own default padding.

textBadgeBackground.description: Fill of each text-only badge: a palette slug or a colour (transparent for plain words). Unset keeps the pill's surface-alt fill.

textBadgeBorderColour.description: Border colour of each text-only badge. Unset keeps the pill's border colour.

textBadgeBorderWidth.description: Border width of each text-only badge as one CSS length (0 draws no border). Unset keeps the pill's 1px.

textBadgeRadius.description: Corner radius of each text-only badge as one CSS length (0 for square corners). Unset keeps the pill's full rounding.

textBadgeSeparator.description: A glyph printed between the badges in every badge style and layout (for example a star), at most 8 characters. Decorative: hidden from screen readers. Unset prints none.

textBadgeSeparatorColour.description: Colour of the separator glyph. Unset takes the text colour.

iconCircleBackgroundGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the icon-circle badge background via a --sgs-trust-badge-circle-bg-gradient custom-property sibling (helpers-tokens.php sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls shape). Non-empty wins over iconCircleBackground (icon-circle variant only).

iconCircleBackgroundHover.description: Hover-state background colour for the icon-circle badge.

iconCircleBackgroundHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of iconCircleBackgroundHover. Non-empty wins over iconCircleBackgroundHover at render time.

iconColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the badge icon's stroke instead of a flat colour (icon-circle variant only). Non-empty wins over iconColour at render time (D636/D644).

iconColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of iconColourGradient. Non-empty wins over iconColourHover at render time.

iconCircleBorderWidth.description: 4-side box-object family (box_family 'iconCircleBorderWidth'). Empty (unset) paints no border (style.css falls back to width 0); a set width paints solid unless another style is chosen (icon-circle variant only).

iconCircleBorderStyle.description: Unset (default) falls through to style.css's framework-default fallback (solid).

iconCircleBorderColour.description: Unset (default) falls through to style.css's framework-default fallback (rgba(0,0,0,0.08)).

gap._comment: Was the bare number "20", which the old flat path read as WordPress spacing-scale SLUG 20 = 0.5rem (theme.json settings.spacing.spacingSizes). A bare number now means px (Bean-ruled 2026-08-10), so the value is stated explicitly to render EXACTLY as before rather than jumping to 20px. This block is pure-wrapper (render.php:86 — gap is handled entirely by the shared wrapper), so it had no render.php fallback shielding it.

gridTemplateColumns.description: A custom grid-template-columns per device. Empty by default: the Columns count drives the grid, and a template set here wins over it.

surfaceBlur.description: Backdrop blur: a single CSS length (for example 24px) that blurs whatever sits behind this block. Emitted by SGS_Container_Wrapper via includes/helpers-surface-ground.php; empty emits nothing.

surfaceSaturate.description: Backdrop saturation as a whole-number percentage (for example 150), paired with surfaceBlur. Unset emits nothing; 0 is a legal value.

centreLastRow.description: Grid layout only. When the last row holds a single badge, centre it under the row above instead of leaving it at the start. Off by default.

overflowMode.description: What happens when the badges do not all fit on one line, where no marquee runs. The ticker itself is the root's stored marquee layer (`sgsMotion`, effect `marquee`; the Overflow control's Ticker writes it with `belowBreakpoint: overflow`, and a newly inserted bar starts with it): 'ticker' (default) and 'wrap' let the badges flow onto further lines wherever no marquee runs. 'drop' keeps a single row and hides whichever trailing badges do not fit (measured live on the frontend by view.js; hidden badges use the native `hidden` attribute so they are never focusable or read by a screen reader), outside a tablet or mobile marquee's range. Ignored while a marquee runs at every width or on overflow: it already keeps a single row.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.
